import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
it = iter(data)

n = next(it)
graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]

for u in range(n):
    m = next(it)
    for _ in range(m):
        v = next(it) - 1
        graph[u].append(v)

color = bytearray(n)
color[0] = 1
stack = [0]

while stack:
    u = stack.pop()
    next_color = 3 - color[u]
    for v in graph[u]:
        if color[v] == 0:
            color[v] = next_color
            stack.append(v)

team1 = []
team2 = []

for i, c in enumerate(color, 1):
    if c == 1:
        team1.append(str(i))
    else:
        team2.append(str(i))

sys.stdout.write(" ".join(team1) + "\n" + " ".join(team2) + "\n")
